scope.purpose: Run the preregistered v2 reference primary-event separability test on fixed prefixes.
non_goals: No video access or video-fact event annotation.
No model/checkpoint access, inference, GPU use, or SoccerMaster training.
scope.label_status: reference-relative silver labels generated without manual overrides

inputs.identity_alignment: ordinal, dataset_index, and reference_commentary exact across manifest/E1/E2; cached dataset_indices exact

silver_label_extraction.rare_rule: raw primary count < 10 merges to other_rare; no exclusion

limitations: Labels describe one reference and are not independently verified video-ground-truth events.
The deterministic sentence splitter and dictionary can miss paraphrases or choose a debatable primary event within a multi-event sentence.
Rare classes are pooled into a heterogeneous other_rare class.
Only 200 fixed post-Q-Former/post-projector prefixes are tested.
Linear-probe separability is associative, not causal, and does not establish generation faithfulness.
